comparison.objective: Gauge seven machined blocks and sort them by dimensional tolerance.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential go/no-go gauge placement, inspection and binning.
comparison.success_condition: Each block validly checked and placed in the correct tray; false accepts/rejects penalized; full result held 1 s. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Both classify objects partly by geometry, but this task tests individual measurement and decision-based binning; the candidate tests passive simultaneous separation of an intermingled load through a screen.
